howto.name: Upload a WebM file
howto.text: Drop a .webm file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: VP9 is re-encoded into a stream QuickTime and Final Cut will actually open.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. The clip is re-encoded into a MOV that QuickTime and Final Cut will open, which they will not do for VP9 WebM.

faq.a: To bring web video into Apple editors (Final Cut, iMovie) that prefer QuickTime/MOV. The codecs differ, so this re-encodes to a MOV-friendly codec like H.264.
Re-encoding causes minor loss; the defaults target visual parity with the source.
No — temporary files, deleted after the download.
